  "title": "Firefox Nightly copies/shares URL from previous tab",
  "body": "Steps to reproduce...\n\n1. Ensure your Firefox Nightly on Android has at least one tab (I have lots!)\n2. Launch a new Firefox tab using an external app\n3. Copy or share the URL\n\nResult...\nThe PREVIOUS tab's URL is copied/shared!!!\n\nExpected...\nThe CURRENT tab's URL is copied/shared\n\nNOTE: Toggling to another tab and back again restores expected copy/share behaviour.\n\nPreviously filed as bz-1687103\n\n┆Issue is synchronized with this [Jira Task](https://mozilla-hub.atlassian.net/browse/FNXV2-9594)\n",

    },

      "id": 775006220,
      "url": "https://github.com/mozilla-mobile/fenix/issues/17791#issuecomment-775006220",
      "body": "Compared to the original issue, which was 100% reproducible, this time it is very intermittent. In fact, I think it is more likely to be triggered by opening a new tab and tapping the address bar, and then sharing, but, once again, it's random.",
      "created_at": "2021-02-08T09:31:08Z",

    },
    {
      "id": 778608497,
      "url": "https://github.com/mozilla-mobile/fenix/issues/17791#issuecomment-778608497",
      "body": "This is a serious issue that's impacting me daily and had caused me much embracement having publicly posted and sent wrong links to people simply because of this serious bug. A bug like this MUST be considered a serious breach of user privacy and even security since people could share secret URLs that contain confidential information, such as login credentials and/or non-public pages. In fact, someone could inadvertently share NSFW URLs without them knowing and could then suffer severe consequences such as job dismissal, etc. As such this issue MUST be taken extremely seriously.",

      "body": "I just hit this. I had one other tab open in Fenix however it didn't seem to be loaded? I opened a link from twitter and on trying to share it the wrong url was copied. The url bar showed the correct address until tapping on it to edit at which point it changed to the wrong url. Eventually I realized I there was another tab, switching to the other tab caused that page to load and on switching back sharing and the url bar was working normally again.",

      "body": "> I can confirm this is happening on the stable version. This exact bug has happened to me multiple times recently on Firefox for android version 86.1.1 (Build #2015794883). Really serious bug and also very frustrating.\r\n\r\nYes, it is a very serious bug and a very frustrating one.\r\n\r\nNote that I don't know if this bug applies to internally and/or externally created tabs, i.e., tabs created from another tab or tabs tabs created by launching a link from another app, but I suspect they result in the same issue. However, I do have a workaround for this bug. That is, when I want to share a newly created tab, in fact any tab, I manually change to the tab above it (as per the tab list) then back to the previous tab (the tab I want to share). Sharing then has always shared the correct tab. Please note that I don't know if this workaround works for the copy operation, but I suspect that it does.",

      "url": "https://github.com/mozilla-mobile/fenix/issues/17791#issuecomment-795305752",
      "body": "This bug should be treated as security relevant since it's leaking information to third parties without the users consent.\r\n\r\nUser wants to share URL A, instead URL B is shared as @mrandreastoth described [above](https://github.com/mozilla-mobile/fenix/issues/17791#issuecomment-778608497).\r\n\r\nI was able to reproduce the bug like this:\r\n* Open URL A\r\n* close Firefox (either use your phone so Android will pause the process eventually, or manually remove Firefox from the recents list)\r\n* Open URL B from another app (e.g. mail client)\r\n* Firefox loads URL B and displays the correct URL below the website\r\n* Click into the address bar -> wrong URL is displayed\r\n* Share the URL -> wrong URL is shared",
